_experiment: coverage-and-coupling campaign joint (c x g) sweep -- protection vs compounding

design.sign_convention: the indicator rises as A(t) falls, so a well-tracking instrument gives a NEGATIVE corr; |corr| is tracking quality
design.severed_control: identical substrate and seed; the coupling response is drawn from the same RNG stream and discarded (Bauch et al. 2016 design)
design.note_g0: at g=0 the coupled and severed conditions are the same run by construction -- the coupling code is never entered; both are reported for symmetry

detection_rule._declared: Frozen on calibration seeds >= 900000 (n=40 per arm) at c=1.0, mid white noise. Applied UNCHANGED at every coverage level, noise colour, severity and consent arm. See spec section 9 amendment 1 for the trend-rule -> level-rule change.

leading.class_mixing: mean of per-class standardised statistic (variance-family only; no covariance across node pairs)
leading.standardisation: z against the same run's baseline period [window-1, 90)

lagging.metric: program-close output, trailing mean over 10 cycles

mid.direction: COMPOUND -- coupling costs more tracking at low coverage than at full coverage

high.direction: PROTECT -- coupling costs less tracking at low coverage than at full coverage
